ar.title: كرشة يمنية (يخنة كبدة وكلاوي)

steps.n1: اغسل الكلاوي وانزع غشاءها، وقطّعها تقطيعاً خشناً وانقعها في عدة مياه. صفّها وجففها. قطّع الكبدة مكعبات صغيرة.
steps.n2: اهرس الثوم مع الكركم والكمون والكزبرة والحبهان حتى يصبح معجوناً كثيفاً.
steps.n3: اقلِ الكلاوي في الزيت مع التقليب حتى تتشرب عصارتها أو تتبخر، ثم ارفعها.
steps.n4: شوّح البصل في الزيت نفسه حتى يذبل، واخفض النار تماماً، وأضف الزنجبيل ومعجون الثوم واطهه 3 دقائق مع التقليب المستمر.
steps.n5: أعد الكلاوي، وارفع النار، وأضف الكبدة واطهها 7–10 دقائق مع استمرار التقليب.
steps.n6: عندما تتحمر الكبدة، أضف الطماطم مع الملح والفلفل واطهها نحو 5 دقائق حتى تنضج الطماطم.

en.title: Yemeni Liver and Kidney Stew (Kirsheh)
en.intro: Recipe 214, page 95 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Wash and skin the kidney, chop it coarsely and soak in several changes of water. Drain and pat dry. Cut the liver into small cubes.
steps.n2: Pound the garlic with the turmeric, cumin, coriander and cardamom into a thick paste.
steps.n3: Fry the kidney in oil, stirring, until its juices have been absorbed or evaporated, then lift it out.
steps.n4: Soften the onions in the same oil, lower the heat right down, add the ginger and garlic paste and cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
steps.n5: Return the kidney, turn up the heat, add the liver and cook for 7–10 minutes, still stirring.
steps.n6: When the liver is browned, add the tomatoes with salt and pepper and cook for about 5 minutes, until the tomatoes are done.

legacySteps: Wash and skin the kidney, chop it coarsely and soak in several changes of water. Drain and pat dry. Cut the liver into small cubes.
Pound the garlic with the turmeric, cumin, coriander and cardamom into a thick paste.
Fry the kidney in oil, stirring, until its juices have been absorbed or evaporated, then lift it out.
Soften the onions in the same oil, lower the heat right down, add the ginger and garlic paste and cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Return the kidney, turn up the heat, add the liver and cook for 7–10 minutes, still stirring.
When the liver is browned, add the tomatoes with salt and pepper and cook for about 5 minutes, until the tomatoes are done.
